summary: OpenRouter API can generate 4 main content types: Text, Images, Video, and Speech/Audio. Text is generated via the `/api/v1/chat/completions` endpoint. Images can be generated from text prompts using AI models with image output capabilities via `/api/v1/chat/completions` with image output support. Video can be generated from text prompts using AI models with video output capabilities via an asynchronous `/api/v1/videos` endpoint with configurable resolution, aspect ratio, and duration. Speech/Audio can be generated through Text-to-Speech (TTS) via the dedicated `/api/v1/audio/speech` endpoint, supporting multiple TTS providers and voices with MP3 or PCM output formats.
facts: Images - generated from text prompts using AI models with image output capabilities
Video - generated from text prompts using AI models with video output capabilities, asynchronous API via /api/v1/videos endpoint
Speech/Audio - Text-to-Speech (TTS) generated via dedicated endpoint /api/v1/audio/speech
Create high-quality images based on text descriptions
Configurable resolution, aspect ratio, duration, and optional reference images support
Multiple TTS providers and voices supported
